svg.title: One sprite from three layers
svg.desc: Isaac's sprite in a battle is three pictures laid over each other: a dark shadow, drawn first, then his body, then his sword on top. The game combines them into one picture and redraws it whenever any layer moves on to another frame. As he attacks, his body and his sword change frame together, so each pose shows the sword in his hand, while the shadow stays the same.
svg.text: drawn again whenever a layer changes frame
HIS ATTACK: BODY AND SWORD MOVE TOGETHER
